newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Basic 1997 net seen up to 108.56 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Basic 1997 net seen up to 108.56 mln pesos.

text.p: Basic Petroleum and Minerals Inc said on Wednesday it expected its net income to rise to 108.56 million pesos this year.
The Philippine oil explorer had reported net income of 7.56 million pesos in 1996.
In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, Basic Petroleum said it expected to derive the bulk of its earnings from its non-oil exploration ventures such as gaming and leisure this year.
For 1998, the company forecast a net income of 337.58 million pesos and 883.41 million in 1999.
